novel.justification: This condition represents a designed-depletion or calibrated loss-to-follow-up regime, rather than ordinary administrative censoring with an atom at the horizon. Concretely, let the observed censoring time be the earlier of two conditionally independent continuous loss or availability times whose conditional survivals each vanish linearly as \(t\uparrow1\); their product has the known quadratic endpoint order, while smooth treatment- and covariate-dependent deviations are absorbed into the unknown residual \(g_a\). The design or external follow-up protocol supplies only the endpoint order \(2\), not the censoring law or \(g_a\), so nuisance learning remains necessary.
